title: kate-core: sentence for a file reload prompt
summary: reload_prompt_line joins the file state and the dirty flag to ReloadChoice::sentence. A missing file has no sentence. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in kate-core. Linux CI runs the test. It does not draw a sheet.

definitions.definition:
#[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]
pub fn reload_prompt_line(file: Option<&FileState>, dirty: bool) -> Option<&'static str>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: A missing file returns None. A file uses reload_choice and then sentence. Quiet returns None. Reload returns Reload the file from disk. Ask returns The file on disk changed. The function has cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code)). Leave reload_choice_for in workspace.rs unchanged. Leave sentence unchanged. This packet draws no sheet. Leave theme.rs, paint.rs, layout.rs, and session.rs unchanged. PKT-0085, PKT-0088, and PKT-0089 own those files. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: document::tests::reload_prompt_line_names_a_dirty_change
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because reload_prompt_line does not exist. A missing file returns None. A clean modified file returns Reload the file from disk. A dirty modified file returns The file on disk changed. A quiet file returns None.
